chain.title: Wire Up the Base
chain.desc: Lead, redstone and glass make 4 Fluxducts. Run them from your dynamos to your machines and stop hand-carrying charged cells - this is the moment your setup becomes a grid.

chain.title: Plumbing
chain.desc: Bronze and lead make 4 Fluiducts. Pipe latex from Arboreal Extractors, crude oil to your dynamos, or water anywhere - fluids finally move without buckets.

chain.title: Make It Pull
chain.desc: Ducts only push by default. Snap a Servo (iron, tin nugget, redstone, glass) onto a duct's connection to a tank or inventory and it actively extracts - the difference between decoration and automation.

chain.title: Sort at the Source
chain.desc: Paper, iron, tin nugget and glass. A Filter on a connection whitelists or blacklists what passes through it, so one line can feed many machines without cross-contamination.

chain.title: Turbocharged Extraction
chain.desc: Upgrade: a Redstone Servo wrapped in invar and lead nuggets. The Turbo Servo pulls far faster - fit these when tier-two machines start outrunning your plumbing.

chain.title: Throttle the Flow
chain.desc: Electrum, lead nugget, redstone and glass. Caps how much RF passes through one connection - meter fragile machines or split one dynamo bank fairly across consumers.

chain.title: Watch It Flow
chain.desc: Bronze around Hardened Glass makes the windowed Fluiduct - same pipe, but you can see the fluid inside. Equal parts diagnostics and base beautification.

chain.title: The Item Buffer
chain.desc: Signalum, tin, quartz and planks. A 9-slot pass-through that collects items and ejects them onward to an adjacent inventory - Dynamics' answer to item logistics, and a tidy hopper upgrade.

notes: Dynamics in 1.20.1 is a small module: exactly 8 registered things - 4 blocks (energy_duct, fluid_duct, fluid_duct_windowed, item_buffer) and 4 attachments - verified as the complete set of recipes, blockstates and loot tables in this jar. The chain is every one of them in adoption order: power ducts first (lead + redstone only), fluid ducts next (needs bronze from Foundation's fire-charge alloying), then the attachment ladder (basic servo/filter on iron and tin, turbo servo on invar plus a Redstone Servo, limiter on electrum), and the two luxuries last (windowed duct needs Hardened Glass from the expansion side; item_buffer needs signalum, which is deep in thermal.json's spine). energy_distributor, fluid_distributor and ender_tunnel exist only as lang keys in assets/thermal_dynamics/lang - no recipe, blockstate or loot table - so they are unimplemented in this build and excluded. There are no dedicated itemducts in Thermal 1.20: item movement is the item_buffer plus machine push/pull, which is worth knowing before a player goes hunting for a pipe that does not exist.
